youtube._note: apiKey is a FALLBACK only. Preferred: set YOUTUBE_API_KEY in Vercel env vars so /api/youtube.js proxies the calls server-side and the key never reaches the browser. Once that works, delete apiKey below and regenerate it in Google Cloud.
youtube._tip: Each channel can have an optional "id" (UC...). If present the site skips the handle lookup, which is faster and immune to handle changes. Find it at youtube.com > your channel > Settings > Advanced.
youtube._howToGetChannelId: Open the channel > click the channel name > Share channel > Copy channel ID. Or on your own channels: youtube.com/account_advanced. Paste it as "id" below. With an id set, the site skips the handle lookup entirely — faster and immune to handle changes.

photon._region: Leave blank to auto-pick a region your app allows (recommended). Set a code like 'au', 'us', 'eu', 'asia' to force one — but it must be enabled in the Photon dashboard under Region Allowlist, or the connection is rejected.
photon._appId: Your live site is using 56ff5627-... — keep whatever is already in YOUR api.json, do not paste this file over it. Replace the line above with your real Realtime App ID before pushing.

discord._setup: 1) discord.com/developers → your app → OAuth2 → Redirects → add EXACTLY https://crixgamingvr.com/flappycrix  2) copy the Client ID below  3) put CLIENT SECRET in Vercel env vars as DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET — never here, this file is public.
_vercelEnvVars: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT = the full service-account JSON on one line

playfab._setup: Get titleId from PlayFab Game Manager -> Title Settings -> API Features. currencyCode must exactly match the 2-character code you create under Economy -> Currency.

voice._setup: Voice chat runs on WebRTC in the browser: audio goes peer to peer and Photon only carries the handshake, so no Voice App ID is needed for it to work. The appId below is for Photon's own Voice SDK, which is a manual download from photonengine.com/sdks (voice / javascript) and is not on npm.
voice._iceServers: STUN alone fails behind a symmetric NAT, which is most mobile networks. Add a TURN server here and calls will relay through it: [{"urls":"turn:your.host:3478","username":"u","credential":"p"}]
